cc:Work.dc:title: C | Shared string storage
cc:Work.dc:description: Exact object reconstruction · uniform and hot-set access · view and copy contracts; all methods and corpora shown. Query cells are ratios of medians of nine trials; lower is faster. Working storage: store capacity + copy/decode workspace; common trace and object headers excluded. Accounted storage is not RSS. Build: median and observed min–max of nine constructions. The two panels are views of one CMU source corpus. No confidence intervals.
